generationInputs.prompt: Hyperrealistic digital food photograph creating a deeply satisfying, visually hypnotic, repeating pattern derived from natural organic forms. The mood is simultaneously healthy, meticulously clean, graphically organized, and subtly calming due to its repetition. Multiple perfect avocado halves, precisely cut lengthwise, are presented with the smooth, dark, pebbled green skin visible. The pit has been expertly removed from each, revealing the flawlessly smooth, creamy, pale green flesh within. These halves are arranged in a precise, repeating diagonal grid pattern, viewed directly from above in a classic flat lay perspective, filling the frame. The background is a seamless, smooth, pale coral pink, providing a warm, contemporary contrast to the greens. Hard, direct overhead lighting casts crisp, identical, dark grey shadows directly beneath each avocado half, reinforcing the strict grid structure and adding depth to the pattern. Every single avocado half is rendered in tack sharp focus, displaying the subtle, beautiful gradient of color within the flesh from the darker green edge near the skin to the paler yellow-green center, occasional faint knife marks from pitting, and the slight natural sheen on the dark skin. Deep depth of field ensures the entire repeating pattern remains perfectly sharp from edge to edge, emphasizing the meticulous arrangement. The color palette creates a striking contrast between the various shades of avocado green and brown skin against the warm, solid coral pink background. Emphasis is placed on the clean, precise cuts, the irresistibly creamy texture of the flesh, and the satisfying, almost meditative visual rhythm established by the flawless repetition.
